svg.title: The Legendre dual swaps the two points
svg.desc: Left: the convex function log(1 + e^theta) for one coin, its tangent at theta0 = -0.4, and the gap 0.6508 at theta1 = 2. Right: the dual function, the negative entropy of a coin, its tangent at eta1 and the gap 0.6508 at eta0; the two divergences are equal with their arguments exchanged.
svg.text: Left: the gap above the tangent at θ₀, measured at θ₁, is D_ψ[θ₁ : θ₀] — the fall of ψ below its tangent (Fig. 1.4 of the book).
Right: the same two coins in η = ψ′(θ), η₀ = 0.401, η₁ = 0.881. The gap above the tangent at η₁, measured at η₀, is D_ψ*[η₀ : η₁].
The two gaps are equal: the Legendre dual swaps the order of the two points and changes nothing else.
